subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: Should the first web Control UI browser release include the full remote interaction, annotation, and element-inspection scope in this PR, or should it land as a narrower staged panel?
rationale: The technical seams already exist, but this protected, large user-facing browser-control surface combines several independently sensitive workflows; repository source and tests cannot decide the intended first-release scope.

options.title: Stage the panel first
options.body: Land navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and composer handoff first, then add annotation and constrained inspection after separate proof and review.

options.title: Sponsor the full scope
options.body: Keep the complete panel in one PR after all four findings are repaired, the branch is rebased, and exact-head live proof covers the edge cases.

options.title: Decline the web browser surface
options.body: Close this PR and the linked feature issue if a first-party remote browser dock is not desired in the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Stage the panel first
recommendation.body: Land navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and composer handoff first, then add annotation and constrained inspection after separate proof and review.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person across the native browser, browser RPC, docked Control UI, and chat attachment owner boundaries needed for the scope decision.
